display.purpose: Hero headlines only. One per page. wdth 62 ultra-condensed.

lede.purpose: Sub-headlines and hero descriptions. wdth 100, weight 400.

label.purpose: IBM Plex Mono — eyebrows, prices, timestamps, nav links, form fields.

button.purpose: Archivo wdth 85, weight 800, uppercase. All buttons.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards and buttons on hover only. Never at rest.

shadows.name: peek-card
shadows.purpose: Playbook preview page cards at rest.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Button hover lift. Fast in, slow settle.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Black bg, vest-yellow text. The default CTA on yellow surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #161615; color: #F3CF2B; padding: 18px 28px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 85; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #000; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: CTA Button (on dark)
components.description: Punch-red bg, warm-white text. The strongest CTA — used only on dark (ink) sections.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #B0201B; color: #F3EFE4; padding: 18px 28px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 85; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: #8B1815; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent, 2px ink border. Used alongside primary when a secondary action is needed.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: transparent; color: #161615; padding: 16px 26px; border-radius: 4px; border: 2px solid #161615; font-family: 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 85; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, transform .2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #161615; color: #F3CF2B; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Nav Brand
components.description: The wordmark. Archivo wdth 70, weight 800, uppercase. Dot in accent red.
components.css: .ds-nav-brand { font-family: 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 70; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em; color: #161615; text-decoration: none; } .ds-dot { color: #B0201B; }

narrative.overview:
This is a bold, hi-vis system built around one central fact about Cody: he's the guy who wears the vest. The page ground is hi-vis yellow (#F3CF2B). Everything sits on it like a time card sitting on a break room table. Headings are huge, condensed, uppercase — they punch you in the face the moment you land. The CTA color is time-clock red (#B0201B), the same red ink a factory punch clock leaves on a card.

The design reflects Cody's actual personality: loud, warm, working-class, real. Not a startup. Not a coach. A guy who figured it out on his lunch break and wants to show you how.

Two fonts. Archivo (a variable condensed sans) handles everything from ultra-compressed display headlines to readable body copy by adjusting the wdth axis. IBM Plex Mono handles labels, prices, timestamps, and anything that reads like a printed form field.
keyCharacteristics: Hi-vis yellow as the entire page ground — not an accent, the whole surface
Punch-clock red (#B0201B) as the only CTA color
Archivo variable font: wdth 62 for condensed headlines, wdth 100 for body
IBM Plex Mono for all label/price/timestamp contexts
Dark sections (ink bg) for emphasis — offer block and footer
Flat by default; shadows only on hover

rules.name: The Vest Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the page. Not an accent. Not a highlight. The entire ground. Everything decorative on top must use ink, red, or green — never another warm hue.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Accent (#B0201B) is the only CTA color. Never use yellow as a button color on yellow backgrounds.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#FFFFFF) does not exist in this system. Light surfaces are vest or stock only.

rules.name: The Condensed-Headlines Rule
rules.body: All h1, h2, h3 use wdth 62, weight 850, uppercase. No exceptions.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Form Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is for anything that reads like a printed form field: prices, timestamps, labels, nav links, eyebrows. Never use it for body copy or headlines.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on hover or focus, always paired with a translateY(-2px) lift.

dos: Do let the yellow breathe — the bg IS the brand
Do use Archivo condensed (wdth 62, weight 850, uppercase) for every headline
Do use IBM Plex Mono for every label, price, timestamp, and eyebrow
Do use accent red (#B0201B) for every CTA button, especially on dark sections
Do use ink bg sections for emphasis moments — offer block, footer
donts: Don't put white on the page — everything light is vest or stock
Don't use a second accent color — red does all the CTA work
Don't use Archivo for label/price/timestamp contexts — that's Mono territory
Don't make headlines mixed case — uppercase always
Don't put a resting shadow on any surface — shadows only on hover
